components.currentBehavior: Checks if template ID is in metaTemplateIds array: ['create-activity', 'create-activity-self-contained', 'evolve-activity-self-contained', 'debug-activity-self-contained']
components.role: Detection - determines which templates get auto-trailblazing and context injection

components.currentBehavior: Auto-enables trailblazing for templates where isMetaTemplate() returns true. Sets: enabled=true, maxRecoveryAttempts=3, maxCostPerTask=1.0, maxTotalCost=5.0
components.desiredBehavior: Same - working correctly after Pass 3 fix
components.role: Auto-configuration - enables dynamic task creation for meta-templates

components.currentBehavior: Queries backend for similar activity executions when isMetaTemplate() is true. Creates impulse with historical patterns. Uses TemplateServiceClient.searchSimilarActivities() to get top 3 relevant executions.
components.role: Context enrichment - provides historical execution data to meta-templates

components.currentBehavior: Checks trailblazingOptions.enabled. If true, delegates to TrailblazingExecutor.executeTaskWithTrailblazing(). If false, uses standard TaskTool execution.
components.role: Execution routing - chooses between trailblazing and standard execution

components.currentBehavior: Executes task with retry loop (maxRecoveryAttempts). On failure, uses ContinuationGenerator to create recovery prompts. Tracks attempts, costs, tokens. Respects maxCostPerTask and maxTotalCost budgets.
components.role: Trailblazing execution - turn-by-turn task creation with AI-generated recovery

components.currentBehavior: Runs before every turn (priority 10). Executes manage-session-memory activity to load relevant context. Skips for activity prefix commands (%) and non-primary agents.
components.role: Memory management - predicts and loads necessary context before LLM invocation

components.currentBehavior: Runs after memory-management (priority 15). When no activity is running and prompt is meaningful (>20 chars), injects activity recommendations based on prompt analysis.
components.role: Activity recommendations - suggests relevant templates based on user intent

components.currentBehavior: Saves activity to local JSON file. Then syncs to backend via metabob_activity_save MCP tool (if available). Calls: metabob-cli MCP -> rpc-api -> SurrealDB. Logs warning if MCP not available.
components.gap: NONE - Architecture enforced: opencode -> CLI MCP -> rpc-api -> SurrealDB
components.role: Data persistence - stores activity execution data in backend for cross-instance access

components.currentBehavior: Extracts component changes from execution. Given changed files and git diff, identifies modified functions/classes using list_file_components. Returns component_changes suitable for backend storage.
components.role: Component extraction - identifies code components affected by activity execution

components.currentBehavior: Provides /v2/activities/templates endpoints for: list (with Thompson Sampling scores), create (auto-creates variants), fetch details, record execution results, get statistics. Uses Redis for storage (MVP).
components.desiredBehavior: Same - working correctly. Note: Redis is MVP, SurrealDB migration planned.
components.gap: NONE - API functional, migration to SurrealDB is future work
components.role: Backend API - provides template management and learning endpoints

components.currentBehavior: Bootstrap template that creates new activity templates. Generates REQUIREMENTS.md, TASK_GRAPH.md, template JSON, registers via MCP, creates SUCCESS.md with usage instructions.
components.role: Meta-template - creates new activity templates dynamically

components.currentBehavior: Bootstrap template that creates variants from parent templates. Analyzes parent metrics, identifies improvements, generates new variant with changes.
components.role: Meta-template - evolves existing templates based on execution data

components.currentBehavior: Bootstrap template that debugs failed activity executions. Uses activity_error_inspector MCP tool to analyze failures, generates EXECUTION_ANALYSIS.md and FIX_RECOMMENDATIONS.md.
components.role: Meta-template - analyzes and fixes failed activity executions

components.currentBehavior: Defines table for per-step execution data with impulse tracking. Fields: execution_id, step_id, success, cost, tokens, duration_ms, impulses_loaded, impulses_created, context_summary. Indexes for performance queries.
components.role: Database schema - stores execution data for learning and analysis

components.currentBehavior: Timeout increased from 5000ms to 15000ms in Pass 3
components.desiredBehavior: Same - 15000ms prevents premature timeouts in K8s
components.role: MCP reliability - prevents timeouts during template registration
